title: plasmashell systemd shutdown order and pipewire dependency
line: At logout or shutdown, Plasma now closes before the sound server, so it no longer fills the log with sound errors or hangs on apps still using audio.
explanation: plasma-plasmashell.service was only ordered after plasma-ksmserver.service, so systemd had no reason to stop the shell before PipeWire or PulseAudio. At shutdown the sound server could therefore disappear while plasmashell and the processes it started were still connected, giving log noise and, in the reporter's case, a hung child that blocked the shell. The change adds pipewire.service, pipewire-pulse.service and pulseaudio.service to the unit's After=, so systemd stops plasmashell first; After= is ordering only and does nothing for units that aren't installed.

commits.message:
shell: stop plasmashell before the sound server at logout

plasma-plasmashell.service had no ordering against PipeWire or
PulseAudio, so at shutdown the sound server could go away while the
shell and its children were still using it. Order the shell after them.

BUG: 510255

patches.diff:
From 78d62b8dbc4f0f15545e5f0b4a7e3022eed6a2e4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 02:25:20 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] shell: stop plasmashell before the sound server at logout

plasma-plasmashell.service had no ordering against PipeWire or
PulseAudio, so at shutdown the sound server could go away while the
shell and its children were still using it. Order the shell after them.

BUG: 510255
---
 shell/plasma-plasmashell.service.in | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/shell/plasma-plasmashell.service.in b/shell/plasma-plasmashell.service.in
index 177c151e73..bec08c1c99 100644
--- a/shell/plasma-plasmashell.service.in
+++ b/shell/plasma-plasmashell.service.in
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 [Unit]
 Description=KDE Plasma Workspace
-After=plasma-ksmserver.service
+After=plasma-ksmserver.service pipewire.service pipewire-pulse.service pulseaudio.service
 PartOf=graphical-session.target
 StartLimitIntervalSec=60s
 StartLimitBurst=3
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Stopping the shell and PipeWire together on master: pipewire.service is gone (red) before plasmashell has stopped (green).
Same stop with the fix: plasmashell stops first, then pipewire-pulse and pipewire.

review.text: Minimal, well-placed systemd user unit ordering fix in plasma-plasmashell.service.in that stops plasmashell before PipeWire, pipewire-pulse, and PulseAudio at logout/shutdown. Using After= is purely an ordering directive so missing services are harmless, and the listed units do not depend on graphical-session.target, avoiding ordering cycles. The before/after systemctl stop transaction logs clearly verify the corrected shutdown sequence.
